mechanism.forced_participant: Passive quote/liquidity providers on the three USD-perp books who withdraw or widen quotes into the scheduled 8:30 ET employment-situation print -- the single highest-variance recurring US data release for risk assets -- because carrying inventory through it violates their inventory/VaR limits. They are forced by the SCHEDULE (a public, exogenous, census-evidenced instant), not by any endogenous price/OI/funding state.
mechanism.late_participant: Lagged labor-news followers: vol-targeting books rebalancing after the print's realized jump, discretionary manual flow, and systematic re-riskers executing over the hours after the release rather than at it.
mechanism.why_effect_exists: NFP resolves wide ex-ante disagreement about the real-economy labor state (no pre-committed outcome; fat-tailed surprise distribution). At 8:30 ET one-sided informed taker flow meets the deliberately thinned book, so the initial repricing is partial; as providers re-quote and late participants execute, the announcement bar's taker side continues. The observable is the announcement bar's taker-quote imbalance -- the flow-side revealed summary of the labor surprise (no payroll-forecast series exists in evidence; the flow reaction IS the surprise proxy).
why_labor_information_differs_from_polic: information type: an FOMC decision resolves a largely PRE-ANCHORED policy expectation (8 scheduled Wednesdays/year, forward-guided); an NFP print is genuine month-specific information about the real economy feeding the policy reaction function only indirectly -- labor-state news, not a policy action

channel: labor strength moves crypto through the growth/discount-rate/risk-appetite COMPOSITE (strong print -> tighter expected path + higher risk appetite; weak print the reverse), a different pricing kernel from a direct policy-rate decision and from the CPI's real-rate channel (sibling P1)

clock structure: 8:30 ET morning print on 24/7 books after the overnight session, vs the dead forms' 14:00 ET decision instants; the 11 NFP dates are census-verified disjoint from both the 8 FOMC instants and the 11 CPI instants

accepted-in-advance ancestry risk: the CONSTRUCTION LAYER of this proposal (announcement-bar imb continuation, H1, 3 symbols, H=6/12) is deliberately the same as dead CNG1-A4-P1 -- the claim is precisely that the labor print's information differs from the policy decision's (plan section 1 declared basis). The FOMC-form shadow rho is therefore this proposal's PRIMARY D2 test: if pooled |rho| > 0.20, the re-clocking interpretation is measured-true and P2 dies at D2 without appeal
when_it_must_fail: if crypto participants fully pre-position into the print, the announcement bar's taker side carries no residual information: anchor after-cost expectancy statistically indistinguishable from zero
if H1 taker-imbalance continuation is generic with no clock needed, the shifted-calendar placebo reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x) and the family is falsified as a re-clocking
if the book is a bare clock artifact, the clock-only shadow out-earns the anchor or correlates > 0.20 with it

if the labor-print book is measurably the dead FOMC-imb book on new dates (or the dvol-shock/tsmom shape that killed it at 0.44087/0.416883), D2 F3 fires -- this is the single most likely death and it is accepted in advance
if a 2-bar delayed entry does at least as well as the instant entry, the print-instant timing carries nothing (F7)
if the clairvoyant control cannot express positive after-cost expectancy at tier 2.0, the battery is a null battery (F6, INVALID_NULL -- not a mechanism falsification)

observable_pinned.definition: imb(symbol, s) = (buy_quote - sell_quote) / quote_total computed on the announcement bar A(s) of the frozen S4 panel
observable_pinned.instant_source: p0_calendar_census_ng2.json instants (series US-MACRO/BLS_EMPLOYMENT_SITUATION_RELEASE), DST-correct UTC per the 8:30 America/New_York print clock

clock.bar: H1 UTC from the frozen S4 panels; bar hour_utc=T covers [T, T+1h)
clock.announcement_bar: A(s) = the H1 bar whose [T, T+1h) interval contains instant_utc: hour_utc == instant_utc floored to the hour (12:30:00Z -> bar '<date>T12'; 13:30:00Z -> bar '<date>T13'); the release lands 30 minutes into A
clock.decision: at the CLOSE of bar A(s) (T+1h), the first bar close strictly after the instant at which the full announcement bar is point-in-time
clock.entry_bar: A(s)+1, the first bar whose open boundary is strictly after the instant; entry fill = last_price of bar A(s) (the last trade observed at the decision close, the ng1 fill convention)
clock.instant_alignment: UTC, DST-correct from the census (8:30 EDT = 12:30Z; 8:30 EST = 13:30Z); no FOMC and no CPI instant exists in this proposal's grid

warmup.rule: an instant is eligible only if (i) >= 24 H1 bars exist in the symbol's panel before the instant's date, (ii) bar A exists with quote_total > 0, (iii) the exit bar A+H exists within panel bounds; any miss drops the instant fail-closed with a recorded reason
warmup.coverage: panel starts 2025-08-22T00; earliest NFP instant 2025-09-05 has 348 bars before its announcement bar A (336 before its date); latest NFP instant 2026-08-07T12:30Z has its A+12 exit bar at 2026-08-08T00, well inside the 2026-08-21T23 panel end; therefore ALL 11 instants x 3 symbols are eligible, zero dropped
warmup.signal_history: none required (anchor direction uses bar A only; no thresholds, no rolling windows, no fitted parameters)

columns_from_panel.buy_quote: USD notional of buy-taker flow in bar (quote units)
columns_from_panel.sell_quote: USD notional of sell-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.quote_total: buy_quote + sell_quote (bar total taker notional, the bounded-ratio denominator)
columns_from_panel.last_price: last traded price in bar, used as the bar-close fill price for entry and exit

features_lags.lag_structure: single-bar feature at lag 0 relative to the decision (bar A itself); exit price at lag +H bars (A+H close). No other lags, no rolling windows, no fitted parameters.

entry_exit_fills.direction: d = sign(imb) = sign((buy_quote - sell_quote)/quote_total) on bar A; exact tie buy_quote == sell_quote -> decision recorded UNFUNDED_SKIP (counted, not silently dropped); missing fields or quote_total == 0 on bar A -> decision recorded UNMEASURED_BAR, dropped fail-closed with count
entry_exit_fills.entry: at close of A(s) (= open of A+1), fill price = last_price of bar A(s), unit notional 1.0 per decision per symbol, no leverage parameter, no sizing conditioning
entry_exit_fills.exit: at close of A(s)+H, fill price = last_price of bar A(s)+H; no stop, no early exit
entry_exit_fills.fills_per_funded_decision: 2 (entry + exit), each charged cost exactly once (L-V14-0)

costs.authority: measured taker + spread schedule at stress tier 2.0 as PRIMARY (Q-2/Q-8), inherited from the V17 scored-driver kernel adoption via ng1; cost exactly once per fill
costs.invention_disclaimer: NO cost constant is stated or invented in this proposal; the measured tier numbers come from the kernel's measured schedule at execution time. Measured beats stated everywhere.

anchor.decisions: 11 NFP instants x 3 symbols = 33 funded decisions (minus exact-tie/unmeasured skips, expected 0)

neighbour.rule: identical direction rule and grid; H = 12 bars
neighbour.mechanism_support: if labor-print flow continuation is real, the longer horizon must retain the sign with graceful decay; a horizon cliff or sign flip contradicts the mechanism (different parameterization, same mechanism)

delay_pair_control.rule: identical direction rule (still computed on bar A) and grid; BOTH fills shifted +2 bars: entry fill = last_price(A+2), exit fill = last_price(A+2+H), H = 6; horizon length preserved
delay_pair_control.purpose: tests print-instant timing specificity: under-reaction continuation decays as late participants execute, so a 2-hour-delayed entry must not dominate the instant entry; the identifiability logic of Q-4 (a control that cannot move the signal would be an INVALID NULL)

clairvoyant_control.rule: identical grid, holds (H = 6), costs and books; direction = sign(last_price(A+H)/last_price(A) - 1) (perfect foresight of the holding-window return); exact tie -> UNFUNDED_SKIP
clairvoyant_control.purpose: machinery validity ceiling: measures the maximum expressible directional edge of the exact fill/cost pipeline; gross expectancy is mechanically >= 0 by construction, so a non-positive AFTER-COST clairvoyant expectancy proves the substrate cannot express any edge at H=6 under tier-2.0 costs (F6 INVALID_NULL); never promotable, never a rescue pool

clock_only_shadow.rule: identical decision grid, holds (H = 6), costs and books; direction = +1 at EVERY decision (pure NFP-clock long exposure carrying zero panel information)
clock_only_shadow.purpose: isolates what the bare exogenous clock yields; if the anchor is subsumed by this exposure the mechanism claim is empty

shifted_calendar_placebo.rule: sham NFP clock: each session index i shifted +1 (session i's decision row placed at session i+1's census instant, DST-correct by construction because the target instant is itself a census instant -- no timestamp fabricated); session 1's row has no predecessor target -> 10 sham instants x 3 symbols = 30 decisions; everything else identical to anchor (H = 6)
shifted_calendar_placebo.sign_freeze: the shift sign is frozen at +1 session (k=+1); the -1 variant is NOT a rescue pool and may never be substituted after any number is visible (P-15); a sham that cannot move the signal is recorded as an identifiability failure, never remediated by flipping k
shifted_calendar_placebo.identifiability: the sham moves instants to real alternate trading days with real microstructure (Q-11 satisfied); it CAN move the signal

arms.pairwise_distinctness: the six arms differ by (direction rule, H, fill timing, instant map) and will carry distinct arm_config_digests at D2/I time; no two arms share all four

representation_identity.p12_statement: This block IS the representation D2 must measure pooled |rho| <= 0.20 on. Representation identity = measurement identity (FXFV9 lesson: no undisclosed variant grids, no monthly-grid maps).
representation_identity.grid: H1 rows keyed (symbol, hour_utc) from the three frozen S4 panels (digests pinned in p0_gate.json s4_repin); decision grid = 33 rows keyed (symbol, instant) over the 11 census NFP instants
representation_identity.signal_computation: per decision row: imb = (buy_quote - sell_quote)/quote_total on bar A; d = sign(imb); entry = last_price(A); exit = last_price(A+H); A = the bar containing the census instant
representation_identity.per_decision_return: r = d * (exit/entry - 1), gross; after-cost r_net = r - 2 * fill_cost_tier2.0 / unit_notional
series_d2_measures: the 33-row per-decision after-cost return vector of ANCHOR (primary)
the same vectors for NEIGH-H12 for the ancestry panel
representation_identity.books: per-symbol books and the pooled 3-symbol book; equal unit notional per decision; no cross-sectional ranking, no normalization across symbols
representation_identity.no_hidden_variants: no alternate k for the sham (k=+1 is THE frozen shift), no alternate sign rule, no horizon outside the declared grid {6, 12}, no alternate span, no monthly aggregation, no sign-flipped re-computation exists or may be substituted at D2; any re-measure must use exactly this representation or be recorded as a NEW proposal

ancestry_defense: The PRIMARY named enemy is this proposal's own dead twin: CNG1-A4-P1 used the IDENTICAL construction layer (announcement-bar taker-quote imbalance continuation, H1, 3 symbols, H=6/12, sign direction, unit notional) on the FOMC clock and died at D2 with anchor worst |rho| 0.44087 vs generic_dvol_shock, 0.432014 vs close_displace_fade, 0.416883 vs tsmom28. P2's defense is NOT a new form -- it is exactly the plan section 1 declared basis: the information source differs (a monthly labor-state print with wide disagreement and no pre-committed outcome, vs a pre-anchored policy decision on 8 Wednesdays), the channel differs (growth/discount/risk-appetite composite vs direct policy action), and the clock differs (11 census NFP instants, dates disjoint from all 8 FOMC instants and all 11 CPI instants). D2 measures this exact representation against the CNG1-A4-P1/P2 anchor and neighbour shadows plus the 29-shape panel; if pooled |rho| > 0.20 the re-clocking interpretation is measured-true and P2 dies at D2 -- accepted in advance, no appeal, no re-parameterization. Secondary ancestors: CNG1-A4-P2 (pre-pressure realization drift, worst 0.398776) used an A-4..A-1 accumulation window that P2 does not have (lag-0 only); WKNDLIQ was a liquidity-LEVEL exposure (0.5628) while P2 conditions on no level, no weekday, no session -- volume appears only inside a bounded ratio; FUNDJUMP carried the funding LEVEL (0.2439) and P2 consumes no funding, no OI; ATTN-PHASE was a recurring session phase and P2's clock is 11 non-recurring exogenous prints; CLOSE-DISPLACE-FADE and RUNPERSIST are endogenous boundary forms dead at any clock -- P2 takes the announcement bar's taker side from an exogenous instant and the sham + clock-shadow + delay controls exist precisely to falsify any re-clocking or generic-drift reading.
distinctness_vs_sibling: P2's information source is the NFP print (labor state) with a FLOW-layer observable (taker-quote imbalance sign); sibling CNG2-A4-P1 uses the CPI print (inflation state) with a PRICE-layer observable (reaction sign from last_price). Different information series AND different observable layer, not a parameter swap. The two decision grids are date-disjoint by census arithmetic (11 NFP dates intersect 11 CPI dates in 0 days), so F5 is expected NOT_COMPUTABLE_GRID_DISJOINT and D2 must record the disjointness proof from the census.

expected_failure_interpretation: If F3 fires against the CNG1-A4-P1 shadow, this proposal's honest thesis (same construction, different information) is measured-false: the labor print re-clocks the dead policy-clock imbalance form, and by plan section 1 the declared basis of the whole inflation/labor frontier collapses -- both A4 proposals die together at D2, which is the cleanest possible negative. If F1 or F7 fires, the NFP clock adds nothing beyond generic H1 imbalance continuation and the family must not be re-shifted or re-clocked. If F4 fires with controls coherent (anchor loses, sham/shadow/delay also lose), it is a plain negative: labor-print flow under-reaction either does not exist at H1 granularity on these three books or is fully eaten by measured tier-2.0 costs. If F6 fires, the substrate cannot express any directional edge at this horizon and the negative-first verdict is recorded as untestable, not as mechanism death. Every outcome feeds CRYPTO_NG2_REJECT_ALL, which the plan registers as a successful research run.
